[[File:Outpost Management Tutorial.png|thumb|Outposts can generate plenty of stock bills over time, which can be earned by trading goods.]]
'''Outpost''' is one of the core mechanic of ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]'', acting as one of the primary source to obtain Regional Stock Bills.

==Overview==
Outposts are available as [[Sub-PAC]]s are unlocked, which the player can trade AIC products to gain Regional Stock Bills and increase the Prosperity of the Outpost. 

Each Outpost starts with deploying a '''Sub-PAC'''. The Sub-PAC and PAC share similar functions. Both can be used as [[TP Point]]s and automatically supply power to Electric Pylons within their Core AIC Areas. Both also expands via [[AIC Steward]].

Stock Bills are accumulated overtime with a limit, and cannot accumulate further once the limit is reached, which the player must trade to allow it continue accumulating. If the Stock Bill in the Outpost was depleted, however, the player cannot trade further, and must wait for it to accumulate.

Prosperity are gained for every base Stock Bill obtained from trading, and maximum prosperity allows upgrades of the Outpost, increasing the Stock Bill limit and Prosperity limit, and unlock new items for trade.

===Operator Assignment===
An [[Operator]] can be assigned to the outpost as the Liaison of the Outpost; When the faction, hobby, and expertise of the Operator matches what was needed for the Outpost, the Outpost's efficiency to gain Prosperity, accumulate Stock Bills or give Stock Bills may increase.

===Area Defense===
Area defense can be accessed through the 'Early Warning Terminal'. By completing the area defense for the outpost, the overall Stock Bills regeneration rate are {{Tip|increased by 5% per level|To be exact, it gives each Stock Bill regenerated have a 5% chance of doubling}}. These bonuses stack with one another and are enabled permanently on completion.

==List of Outposts==
All Outposts are tied to a [[Mission]], with those that are the first to the region are tied to a [[Mission/Main|Main Mission]], while others tied to a [[Mission/Side|Side Mission]].

A Side Mission will also be available once the Outposts reached maximum prosperity, which is required to be completed for upgrading the Outpost.
